Three ways to keep a garden of notes.

## Obsidian

price: free
storage: local files

- ✅ Plain markdown
- ✅ Plugins
- ❌ Sync costs extra

## Notion

- price: from $10
- storage: cloud

+ Databases
- Slow offline
- Lock-in

## Paper

### Pros

- Nothing to install

### Cons

- No search

Ink and a notebook.
